items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: when they went to New York they got Freddy Greene... I met Basie, and Basie's whole band... Like Freddy Green. When he would come to Chicago, Count would always tell me, John, come to New York... we'll look out for you.

ctx.x: This was with -- Lester was with Basie.

They left Kansas City and they came to the Grand Terrace. This was their first trip out of Kansas City. This was a trip before -- this was the engagement, rather, before they went to New York. They were on their way to New York then. They had a guitar player with them then, incidentally, by the name of -- oh, gosh, I can't remember his name. He played violin also. But it wasn't Freddy Green. I think his name was Williamson, something else. I'll think of it. But a very good guitarist. And played violin, fiddle…

But any way, they would come down and Count Basie would come to the club in a raincoat, and it was 10 below zero. They were that poor. But any way, tremendous -- musically it was just something else. Chy Choo, Ben, you know, Prez, it was -- they were all different. But they ---
